title: Captions show safe-area guides and their own bar on the timeline, as the captions mock draws them
goal: The captions mock shows three things the app does not have yet: title-safe and action-safe guides you can switch on over the picture, a small badge on the picture saying captions are automatic and in which language, and a bar above the Captions track with the word being said, the time, Clear and Reset. The captions options also sit at the top of the panel in the mock, not under Effects.
notes: Left from captions-write-themselves-from-the-speech (2026-09-23). Mock: docs/design/mocks/pages/video-captions.html (#safeBtn, AUTO · EN chip on the stage, the .captrack header row: CAPTION TRACK auto · word level, Clear, Reset, Active word <w>, 1.30s / 6.00s). Captions panel is Sources/Photonz/CaptionsInspector.swift; the look and track model live in Sources/PhotonzCore/CaptionLook.swift; the Captions track row and Words lane are TimelineTrackRows.swift + CaptionWordsLane.swift. Section order is InspectorPanel.swift availableSections.
acceptance: A Guides row in the Captions section switches title-safe (90%) and action-safe (93%) guides on the canvas, labelled as the mock labels them
The canvas carries the mock AUTO · EN badge while captions are automatic
A bar over the Captions track reads the active word and the playhead time, with Clear and Reset, as video-captions.html draws it
With a caption picked, the Captions options are the first section under Layers
A walk with no flags photographs the guides, the badge and the bar

log.note: manager 2026-09-24: also from queue/audits/2026-09-24-editing-session-walk.json: the Captions panel's Generate row squeezes its button to 'Write Ag...' beside '10 captions'. Fix it while moving the Captions options to the top of the panel.
